recent_excerpts: Censys researchers detail a CFO's phone compromise: banking apps, executive email, MFA prompts exposed. Learn the DFIR steps to contain and recover from a high-value mobile breach.
CISA's postmortem on a GitHub leak exposing 844 MB of internal data, including AWS GovCloud keys, reveals the agency ignored nine automated alerts and took 48 hours to rotate...
Kaspersky Compromise Assessment 2025 findings: 60% of incidents lacked high-confidence alerts; 30.8% of threats persisted over 3 months; 40% of web shells hid in backups.
